item.title: Service Disruption [resolved]
item.description:
**Incident Summary**
On February 10, 2026, between approximately 10:15 PM and 11:30 PM CET, some Prismic customers experienced difficulties logging in and accessing their repositories. These issues were caused by a DNS resolution failure on [AWS CloudFront](https://health.aws.com/health/status), one of the infrastructure providers Prismic relies on.
**What Happened**
• AWS identified the root cause and progressively restored normal operations.
• All Prismic services returned to full availability by late evening CET.
• We identified gaps in our alerting that delayed our awareness of the issue.
